jobs.description:
Do you enjoy physical work and don't mind working in a cold environment? Are you comfortable working in the meat industry (pork)? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

For our client’s deboning department, we are looking for a motivated employee with experience as a butcher, meat deboner, or within the meat processing industry.

Your Profile

• Experience as a butcher, deboner, or within the meat industry is a strong asset.
• You are motivated and enjoy hands-on work.
• You preferably speak and understand at least two of the following languages: Dutch, English, or Polish.
• If you speak one of these languages well, you are also welcome to apply.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.

Your Responsibilities

• Deboning and processing pork products.
• Working according to quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
• Cooperating with colleagues in a production environment.
• Keeping your workplace clean, organized, and safe.

We are looking for Motivated Packers of rice cookies!
We are urgently looking for people who can support our client in Zottegem. 

If you know how to tackle things, read on further! 

What are our expectations? 
• You are responsible for packing food products.
• You will keep basic records relating to your workstation.
• You will work in a 2-shift system (Monday to Friday, one week from 06h00 to 14h00 and the next week from 14h00 to 22h00).
• Fine work is not a problem for you.
• You work at a fast pace.
• You have a stable CV and positive references. 
• You are fluent in Dutch or English.

Do you have experience as an operator? 
Do you also know how to drive a forklift truck? 

Then we are looking for you!

For a company in Kluisbergen we are looking for a logistic operator. 

You will work in two shifts. 

• experience as forklift driver
• experience as operator
• good knowledge of English

We’re looking for people who enjoy doing hands-on work!This position is with a company that specializes in ham production.The company is located in Oudenaarde and is looking for employees to work in two shifts.
What will your responsibilities be?

• Maintaining the machines, equipment, and the building itself
• Performing scheduled maintenance and repairs
• Ensuring the machines operate at peak performance

Who are you?

• You have experience performing maintenance work
• You speak English or Dutch
• You have your own transportation

For a company in the Waregem region, we are looking for an all-round (multi-skilled) employee. You will work in a company that processes second-hand clothing.

What does the job involve?

• You assist with the initial sorting process (on top of the sorting installation).
• You are responsible for removing and transporting the initially sorted items.
• You assist our drivers with manual unloading.

• Dynamic
• Good physical condition
• Insightful, able to work independently
• No dust allergy
• Forklift experience + certificate = a plus
• You speak French / English or Dutch fluently

Are you looking for a new challenge that will (fork)lift your spirits? Be sure to read further! 
We are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver for a company specialized in the construction and interior sector. 

What are your tasks? 

• Responsibility of operating the line
• Safely but quickly move goods on and off trucks using a forklift
• Place items in the correct storage locations and stack them securely
• Move pallets and products between the dock, warehouse, and storage areas
• Respect safety rules, wear protective equipment, and ensure a safe working environment

What do we expect from you? 

• You are a motivated candidate who is ready to pick up their new tasks quickly
• You have broad experience as a forklift driver
• You are in possession of a forklift certificate
• You have your own car
• You speak English well
• You are aware of the importance of following health and safety guidelines

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

Do you have experience in micro welding? Are you open for a production job? Does the world of railway and airspace interests you? Then this is a job for you. Our client, a great player in the world of logistics, is looking for a handy production employee. They are looking in the department that makes the black boxes is looking for a new colleague. 

The job

• operating the pick and place machine
• micro welding of different electronic components
• assembling and wiring of electronic components 
• quality check of the production proces 

• very good knowledge of French and English
• experience in micro welding

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

With a strong international presence, the organization collaborates with policymakers, industry leaders, regulatory bodies, and civil society stakeholders to address evolving economic and societal challenges. Its multidisciplinary approach combines analytical expertise, evidence-based policy development, and constructive dialogue to drive meaningful and lasting impact.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Monitor and analyse European and international policy, regulatory, and market developments relevant to consumers and businesses.
• Conduct research and provide evidence-based analysis on economic, regulatory, and market-related topics.
• Translate complex policy, economic, and regulatory information into clear recommendations and strategic insights.
• Support the development and implementation of advocacy, public affairs, and policy initiatives.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, industry representatives, regulatory bodies, and other key stakeholders.
• Represent the organization in meetings, conferences, working groups, and external events.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maximize the impact of policy and advocacy activities.
• Prepare policy papers, briefing notes, position statements, and stakeholder communications.
• Support the planning and execution of stakeholder engagement activities and events.
• Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities, and contribute innovative ideas to strengthen the organization's influence and impact.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, Business, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related discipline.
• Relevant experience in public affairs, policy, advocacy, consultancy, regulatory affairs, or a comparable environment.
• Strong understanding of economic and market trends and their impact on consumers and businesses.
• Good knowledge of the European policy and regulatory landscape.
• Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences.
• Proven ability to build relationships and engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Confident, proactive, and capable of representing an organization externally.
• Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Innovative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and challenge conventional thinking.

BelPro Chocolate Masters is a growing chocolate manufacturer in Duffel. We are looking for a motivated recent graduate or junior professional who wants to develop practical experience in Quality & Food Safety within a real food-production environment. 

You will work closely with the Operations Manager and experienced external specialists. You will support the development and day-to-day maintenance of our Quality Management System (QMS), HACCP, GMP, hygiene and food-safety activities. 

Your activities will include supporting procedures and quality records, following up quality requirements on the production floor, traceability exercises, internal checks, non-conformities and corrective actions, internal audits, supplier and raw-material documentation, and preparation for future IFS Food certification. 

We are looking for someone with a background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. Previous food-industry experience is an advantage but is not required. 

Good English is important. Dutch is an advantage. 

We offer a practical opportunity to learn, contribute and gradually take on more responsibility as BelPro continues to grow.

• Background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. 

• Basic knowledge of HACCP, microbiology, food safety, quality systems or food processing is an advantage. 

• Structured, practical and willing to learn. 

• Comfortable working both with documentation and on the production floor. 

• Able to communicate and cooperate with production and management. 

• Previous food-manufacturing experience is an advantage, but not required.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

jobs.occupation: Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry
jobs.description:
Our client is a global veterinary health company specialized in the research, development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products and vaccines for companion animals and livestock market. With a presence in 50 countries, our client is recognized as one of the top animal health companies worldwide. 

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following responsibilities:

Veterinary Service Manager: 

• Serve as the technical expert for animal health products (pharma & vaccines) for poultry 
• Provide scientific and technical support to veterinarians, farmers, and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Conduct training sessions, seminars, round tables and product demonstrations for veterinarians, farmers and distributors across the Benelux region.
• Develop your network of Key Opinion Leader (KOLs) within the poultry sector in the Benelux region. 
• Support the launch of new products by highlighting the technical & scientific benefits of the new products. 

Internal Collaboration:

• Work closely with the Sales teams to enhance customer engagement for Poultry products.
• Collaborate with the marketing team in the BENEDACH by providing technical & scientific advice on the creation of marketing support.

Market analysis & awareness: 

• Organize and participate to events and congresses to develop your network within the animal health industry and the expand the pharma, medicines and vaccines visibility within the Poultry sector.
• Represent the company at conferences, trade shows, and professional events.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging health challenges.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

As a successful Veterinary Product Specialist - Pharma & Vaccines Poultry - Benelux, you have the following profile:

• Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) degree, Master Degree in Agriculture or equivalent.
• Experience / Knowledge in Poultry is mandatory. 
• You are autonomous with the willingness to travel in the Benelux region. 
• Ability to translate complex scientific information into practical guidance.
• Fluent in Dutch & English with a intermediate knowledge of French.

Are you detail-oriented, client-focused, and experienced in KYC and compliance processes? We are looking for a Client Administration Officer to play a key role in managing client files and ensuring compliance within a leading financial services environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established and reputable financial institution specializing in wealth management and investment services. With a strong focus on expertise, long-term relationships, and service excellence, the company offers a collaborative and professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and develop their careers.

Omschrijving

• Manage the full lifecycle of client files, from onboarding to closure.
• Perform AML/KYC checks and assess client documentation and risk profiles.
• Collect, verify, and maintain accurate client data.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with commercial, legal, and compliance teams.
• Identify and report operational risks when necessary.
• Participate in various departmental and process improvement projects.

• Previous experience in a similar administrative, KYC, compliance, or client support role within the financial services sector.
• Good knowledge of AML, KYC, MiFID, FATCA, CRS, GDPR, or similar regulations.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• A proactive team player with strong communication abilities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

Jobomschrijving

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.
